### Done: “Nav” via published page listing on home

- **Added a published-pages query + index** so the public site can efficiently list live pages:

```24:33:convex/pages.ts
export const listPublished = queryGeneric({
  args: {},
  handler: async (ctx) => {
    return await ctx.db
      .query("pages")
      .withIndex("by_published_updatedAt", (q) => q.eq("published", true))
      .order("desc")
      .collect();
  },
});
```

```8:20:convex/schema.ts
export default defineSchema({
  pages: defineTable({
    slug: v.string(),
    title: v.string(),
    body: v.string(),
    published: v.boolean(),
    createdAt: v.number(),
    updatedAt: v.number(),
  })
    .index("by_slug", ["slug"])
    .index("by_published_updatedAt", ["published", "updatedAt"])
    .index("by_updatedAt", ["updatedAt"]),
});
```
